Clocker kiosk, Direction B

A mock only: nothing is built. Every screen and state the shared Clocker tablet has today, restyled in Direction B with the kiosk's own flow, rules and words. Each frame sits beside today's capture (the Release 1 iPad presentation, NEVORA_CLOCKER_UI_V2=true, fictional data and a fictional tablet). Frames are 1024 × 768 landscape, with a few at 768 × 1024 portrait. Fictional data: Northside Café & Bakery, Calle Loíza, James Ortiz.

Green: done or workingAmber: wait or check firstRed: stops youGrey: off clock or information

The system

  • The teal band carries the wordmark, the workspace, the location and the live clock and date as its large figure, with the tablet's status in glass at the foot.
  • The task is one lifted white card (22px radius) on the canvas. Pills for buttons (56px; 64px in portrait), 84px action rows with 56px icon circles, 76px keypad keys (96px in portrait). Every headline status icon is a 64px ring: red stop, amber wait or check, green done, teal information. Inter throughout.
  • Round 2 adds new copy only where marked NEW COPY in a frame's note (success lines and what Recording is doing); those need Jose's yes.
  • Flow, rules, timers (20s PIN entry, 30s private screen, 8s receipt) and copy are unchanged.

Reduced motion

  • Today's Release 1 kiosk has no entrance motion and turns every animation off under prefers-reduced-motion; Direction B keeps that.
  • New, motion allowed only: the wrong-PIN field shakes once (220ms), the success check pops and draws in (about 400ms), the Recording bar runs. Under reduced motion the field only turns red, the check fades in (200ms), and the bar and spinner are still; the words carry every state.
  • The clock still updates each second (text, no motion). The page itself plays these (open it to see them); the PNG shots are still frames.

Hardware keyboard and focus

  • The PIN field takes focus on arrival and after every clear, so a keyboard types digits straight in; Enter submits (it's a form); Escape anywhere clears the screen back to the PIN.
  • Tab order: Skip to time clock, then the card: keys 1–9, Clear, 0, delete, Continue, Español. On each new state the card's heading takes focus so it's announced.
  • Focus ring: 3px teal (#0B6E69) at 3px offset on the card, white on the band. Keys, pills and action rows are buttons with the kiosk's exact English names.

3. Clock state and actions
